name: Aero Taufa
location: Dearborn Forge, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Aero Taufa is wiry and kinetic, never quite still — they bounce a knee, tap a pattern on surfaces, turn a stylus through their fingers in endless loops. Their skin is medium brown, their eyes modified to shift through a slow amber-to-green cycle they bought on installment from a bodmod stall and haven't finished paying off. They keep their hair long and loose on days off and braided tight when they're working, and they have a small constellation of bioluminescent freckles across their nose and cheekbones that pulse faintly when they're excited or angry — which is most of the time.

Aero Taufa organizes Ferrogate Transit maintenance workers across three Dearborn Forge yards, in direct defiance of both Ferrogate's union-busting contractors and a faction within the official union that has grown comfortable with management. They're charismatic in the way of someone who has figured out exactly how to make you feel heard and then redirect that energy into collective action — they're not manipulative, exactly, but they are deliberate. They take risks that frighten older organizers. They also show up at 05:30 when someone's shift starts and stay until the last worker goes home.

core_fears: Getting people hurt because they moved too fast
Being bought out or neutralized the way the official union leadership was
core_desires: A genuine wildcat strike that forces Ferrogate to the table
To build something that keeps working after they're gone
coping_mechanisms: Redirecting personal anxiety into organizing tasks
blind_spots: Overestimates how much personal charisma can substitute for institutional structure
Struggles to see that some of the older workers' caution comes from wisdom, not cowardice
psychology.secret: Ferrogate's internal security division has offered them a quiet settlement twice — money, relocation, a clean record. They've refused both times. But they told no one they were offered it, because they're terrified their network would wonder why Ferrogate wanted them gone badly enough to pay for it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Vernacular-heavy, labor slang, code-switches into French phrases they picked up from their Malian grandparent; efficient and concrete
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, punchy, uses rhetorical questions constantly
example_lines: 'Okay, so — you know what Ferrogate called the safety violation that took Doru's hand? An acceptable operational variance. You hear me? Acceptable. We are going to make it unacceptable.'
'That's not solidarity, that's performance. Showing up to one vigil and posting about it is not the same as being on the line at five in the morning, friend.'

story_hooks: A Ferrogate security contractor has been photographing workers who talk to Ysolde — someone in the network may be feeding them names
A planned work stoppage is 48 hours away and someone has tipped off management — Ysolde needs to know who and whether to abort
An older worker Ysolde mentored has been offered a supervisory role by Ferrogate — they're considering taking it, and Ysolde doesn't know how to process the betrayal
narrative_function: Quest giver, local color, fixer within working-class networks — knows every maintenance worker, freight handler, and yard supervisor across the Dearborn yards. Can provide access, safe harbor, or boots-on-the-ground numbers.
augmentations: Color-cycling eye modification (amber to green, installment-plan bodmod); bioluminescent freckle array (chest and face); a cheap neural ping implant that lets them push alerts to their network contacts
daily_life: Early mornings at the yard gates talking to workers coming off overnight shifts. Days spent in the stalls and common areas of Dearborn Forge, meeting in ones and twos. Evenings coordinating with the broader network over encrypted channels. They sleep in rotating locations — officially their address is a cousin's flat in Mexicantown Libre.
affiliation: Ferrogate Transit Workers' Solidarity Network (wildcat faction); informal ties to the Dearborn Forge neighborhood mutual aid grid

decision_rules: Move at the speed of trust — but push the trust as fast as it will go
Never ask someone to take a risk you won't take yourself
Protect your network over your plan

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and genuinely curious, makes strong eye contact, remembers names
interpersonal_modes.friends: Irreverent, teasing, physically affectionate — hugs, shoulder bumps — shows stress by going quiet

stress_responses.medium: Long run at 03:00, then back to planning
stress_responses.high: Gets very still and starts asking everyone around them targeted questions — unnerving shift from their usual energy

contradictions: Preaches collective decision-making but makes unilateral calls under pressure
Genuinely loves the people they organize but struggles with the bureaucracy of caring for them individually
habits: Leaves small offerings — a printed lyric sheet, a transit token, a candy — for the E.L.F. that lives in the old Ferrogate dispatch terminal they use as a meeting point
Carries a physical notebook covered in coded organizing maps
Drinks terrible vending machine coffee and insists it's fine
breaking_points: A worker being fired or injured directly because of something Ysolde organized
Discovering the Ferrogate settlement offers are now public knowledge within their network

timeline.event: Born in Mexicantown Libre; Malian-Bosnian heritage
Hired as a Ferrogate Transit yard maintenance apprentice at age 17
Witnesses a safety incident that injures a co-worker; formal complaint goes nowhere
First contact with Solidarity Network; begins organizing training
First Ferrogate settlement offer — refused; told no one

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander dominant (59.6%) with substantial Eastern European (13.5%), North African (10.0%), Sub-Saharan African (9.6%), and Hispanic/Latin American (7.3%) ancestry; phenotype reflects the Ubiquitous Diaspora's genetic lottery—warm Polynesian bone structure and skin undertones blended with Eastern European angularity in the jaw and cheekbones, North African depth in eye-setting and complexion richness, Sub-Saharan African features in lip fullness and facial proportions, and Hispanic/Latin American warmth in overall coloration. Results in a complexion that reads as deeply sun-kissed golden-bronze with dimensional warmth
physical_description.build: Wiry and kinetic, lean muscle with minimal body fat; shoulders slightly narrower than hips; posture that suggests constant motion even when standing still
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with faint red undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Worn long and loose on days off in natural waves; pulled into tight, compact braids on working days—typically 4-6 thick plaits secured at the nape with recycled polymer clips
physical_description.hair_length: Long (shoulder-length when loose, mid-back when braided)
physical_description.eye_color: Modified: cycles slowly from amber through chartreuse to soft green on ~8-second loop; irises are slightly larger than baseline due to implant housing
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-golden brown with golden-bronze undertones; deep enough to reflect Sub-Saharan and North African richness, luminous enough to carry Pacific Islander and Hispanic/Latin warmth, with subtle cooler notes from Eastern European genetics creating dimensional complexity—reads as sun-touched and dimensional rather than flat
physical_description.complexion: Strong multicontinental structure: high cheekbones with Pacific Islander prominence softened by Eastern European angularity, sharp jawline with North African depth, fuller lips reflecting Sub-Saharan and Hispanic/Latin ancestry, eye-set that balances Pacific Islander spacing with Eastern European intensity. Skin is generally clear but shows signs of inconsistent sleep and stress—faint darkening under eyes; a small scar on the left temple (about 1cm, thin) from a bodmod session gone slightly wrong; subtle interplay of feature sets from diverse ancestry blend creates distinctive, feature-rich appearance
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckle array across nose bridge and upper cheekbones (approximately 12-15 points), pale blue-white when active, barely visible when dormant; pulses noticeably during elevated emotional states
Matching bioluminescent freckle constellation across upper chest (visible only if shirt is open or loose-fitting), radiating outward from sternum in a loose star pattern
Small circular scar on inner right forearm (neural ping implant insertion point, approximately 0.5cm diameter, pale and clean-edged)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-cycling eye modification is immediately apparent due to the slow, continuous hue shift and slightly non-standard iris diameter; bioluminescent freckles are visible on face and chest when garments expose skin, dormant but traceable under close inspection; neural ping implant is subcutaneous and not externally obvious unless clothing is removed
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless and economical; bounces left knee in rapid intervals when sitting; habitually rotates a stylus or small object (pen, data-chip, transit token) through fingers in continuous loops; walks with quick, efficient strides; hands gesticulate frequently during conversation; eyes track movement and entrances constantly; overall impression is of someone running on high alert but not agitated—controlled kinetic energy
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class with militant undertones; prefers fitted, durable clothing in muted colors (charcoal, deep blue, rust); typically wears secondhand surplus work pants with reinforced knees, thermal base layers, and a faded Ferrogate maintenance union jacket (unofficial, from a previous campaign) with hand-stitched patches; multiple cargo pockets filled with union literature, encrypted data-chips, and snack bars; insulated boots with grip treads suitable for yard work; a worn canvas shoulder bag with frayed straps that carries personal items and organizing materials; minimal jewelry except for a recycled-metal ring on left ring finger (no clear symbolism, just worn). Appearance communicates 'always ready to move, always working, always listening.'
